title: Harbor (official)
description: Upstream example dashboard of Harbor 2.15.4, https://github.com/goharbor/harbor/blob/v2.15.4/contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json (linked from the Harbor metrics docs). Changes: datasource pinned (variable removed), intro text, panel descriptions (upstream has one), lab annotations and links, refresh 10s -> 1m. Queries unchanged.

panels.description: How to read this dashboard.

options.content:
### Harbor: upstream example dashboard (Harbor 2.15.4)
Harbor's own dashboard from the Harbor repository (`contrib/grafana-dashboard/metrics-example.json` at tag v2.15.4), kept for reference: per-project content, core API, Go runtime of the scraped processes, job queues and registry traffic. The day-to-day view is **Harbor** (curated), which adds error ratios, latency percentiles, storage latency, job results and resources. Expected empty: *task concurrency* (only while jobs run). Upstream panel queries are unchanged. Docs: `docs/dashboards/security.md`.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: component up status
panels.description: harbor_up per component (core, database, jobservice, portal, redis, registry, registryctl, trivy) as seen by the exporter: 1 = up. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).
harbor_project_quota_usage_byte: storage used per project (pie). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).
panels.title: Quota Usage
project members
panels.description: harbor_project_member_total: members per project. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: Project repo total
panels.description: harbor_project_repo_total: repositories per project. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: artifacts pulled
panels.description: harbor_artifact_pulled: pull count per project stored in the database (only grows). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: harbor core request rate
panels.description: rate of harbor_core_http_request_total per series (operation, method, code), including the liveness probe (GetPing) and the exporter (GetHealth). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: API request time 0.9
panels.description: harbor_core_http_request_duration_seconds quantile 0.9 per operation (summary computed in core over a sliding window). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: harbor core inflight requests
panels.description: harbor_core_http_inflight_requests: requests core is serving now. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: Process opened fd
panels.description: process_open_fds of the scraped Harbor processes (core, exporter, jobservice, registry); compare with process_max_fds.

panels.title: Process CPU time
panels.description: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total): CPU cores used by each scraped Harbor process.

panels.title: go threads
panels.description: go_threads: OS threads of each Harbor Go process.

panels.title: goroutines
panels.description: go_goroutines of each Harbor Go process; a steady climb suggests a leak.

panels.title: Go heap objects
panels.description: go_memstats_heap_objects: live heap objects per process.
go_memstats_alloc_bytes: heap bytes allocated and in use per process.
panels.title: go allocated  memory
go next gc bytes
panels.description: go_memstats_next_gc_bytes: heap size at which the next GC runs.

panels.title: go gc time 0.25
panels.description: go_gc_duration_seconds quantile 0.25: GC pause duration.

panels.title: go gc time 0.5
panels.description: go_gc_duration_seconds quantile 0.5: GC pause duration.
go_gc_duration_seconds quantile 0.75: GC pause duration.
panels.title: go gc time 0.75

panels.description: time period from last process of task queue
panels.title: task latency

panels.description: harbor_task_concurrency: jobs running per type and pool. The series exist only while jobs run (empty = idle). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).
panels.title: task concurrency
task queue pending size
panels.description: harbor_task_queue_size: jobs waiting per type in the jobservice queue. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

rate of harbor_task_scheduled_total (a gauge upstream applies rate() to; changes only when schedules are added or removed). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).
panels.title: tasks per minute
number of running scheduled jobs
panels.description: harbor_task_scheduled_total: scheduled (periodic) jobs registered. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: Registry request inflight
panels.description: registry_http_in_flight_requests per handler. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: Registry request rate
panels.description: rate of registry_http_requests_total per handler, method and code. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: registry request time 0.9
panels.description: p90 of registry_http_request_duration_seconds over 10m, per series. Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: registry request size 0.9
panels.description: p90 of registry_http_request_size_bytes over 10m (push body sizes). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).

panels.title: registry response size 0.9
panels.description: p90 of registry_http_response_size_bytes over 10m (pull body sizes). Source: Harbor metrics docs (https://goharbor.io/docs/main/administration/metrics/).
